component.name: DrawKit
component.summary: Paint with brushes, layers and a GPU canvas

description.p: DrawKit is a painting application built on one Rust engine and a native GTK4 shell. The canvas, brush, eraser and fill are the same code the macOS, iPad and Android versions run.

ul.li: Soft and textured brushes with pressure, dual tips and wet media
Layer tree with groups, clipping and fill layers
A fill that reaches the anti-aliased line instead of leaving a pale rim
GPU compositing, presented through a Wayland surface
Projects in the lossless .dkp stroke-tape format

screenshot.caption: The canvas, brush controls and layer tree

description.p: First alpha of the GTK4 shell: painting, layers, undo, the GPU canvas and .dkp files.
